notes: Episodes you have wear a soft green glass instead of a tick. Pick the dub: the player's settings menu lists a film's audio tracks and starts on the title's original language. Press an episode you don't have to save its best source — the card shows the download; hold OK for Sources, Mark watched and Play; a Mark season watched pill under the seasons. Trailers open in the TV's YouTube app. Updates ask for Android's install permission first, with the settings path spelled out.
